prior_threads.reason: The treasure is still unfound. Father William added marks to the map (beat_53) and the party plans to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow (beat_81).

The danger changed in nature and questions were partly answered: the lair is at the foot of the northern mountains, and the dragon will soon fly (beat_56). It is said to need Brandon's sword to kill (beat_47), and the Reeve's 1000 gold is now in doubt (beat_58).

The question of what the Clurichen does in town was answered: Naggeneen drinks Quinn's ale (beat_15). He is captured but not destroyed and hangs in a bag behind Quinn's bar (beat_18, beat_39), and his offer of a pot of gold or a secret for release remains.
Shipments still have not come in, and the cause is unknown.
Not touched this Session; Ned's outside offer stands.
Dunk offered 20 gold for the mule. Gill would go lower only once his boys return, so the mule is not yet obtained.
The ale thief, Naggeneen, was caught and handed to Quinn. Quinn paid the party for it (beat_18), so nothing remains owed or unknown.

new_threads.name: Squints and the Halfling Corps
new_threads.reason: Squints joined under Trout's terms, including second pick of the first treasure after the elite members (beat_42). Those terms remain owed, and Trout secretly plans not to protect him.

new_threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
new_threads.reason: Dunk wants the magical mithril shirt and has a plan to get it. He told the party it could help against the dragon (beat_77), which gives it a stated purpose.

new_threads.name: Dunk's sleeping-potion deal with Ingrid
new_threads.reason: Dunk supplied faun wine, heavily diluted (beat_82), so Ingrid can brew a sleeping potion. He promised to help her get it into Warwick's house, and they meet again tonight. It is the plan Dunk told the party would get him the armour (beat_77).

new_threads.name: Brandon's sword in the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: Father William says the dragon cannot be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_47), and the party set out for the Barrow to get it (beat_81).

new_threads.name: Father William's offer of healing
new_threads.reason: Father William offered to heal Uriah if he is injured, an outside offer that remains available.

new_threads.name: Uriah's penance and donation for the Barrow
new_threads.reason: In return for marking the map, Uriah agreed to give penance at the Barrow Mound and donate 10 gold for its upkeep. Neither is done yet.

new_threads.name: The giant in the stone cottage
new_threads.reason: The party robbed the man-eating giant of its captive and escaped when it tired (beat_91), but it remains in the woods north of town.

new_threads.name: Brother Dirk
new_threads.reason: The rescued Dirk wants to go home, while Sir Phidipaldi objects and Trout assigned him to Squints (beat_94, beat_95). Whether he stays with the party is unsettled.
